wikiFields.description: Elite Spell. All foes in the area take 15...51...60 earth damage and are Weakened for 1...8...10 second[s]. Nearby foes also take +15...51...60 earth damage and have Cracked Armor for 1...8...10 second[s]. Adjacent foes suffer the previous effects, take +15...51...60 earth damage, and are Blinded for 1...8...10 second[s].
